title: Topic 2.3: Crop Pest and Disease Control

pages.lesson:
LESSON: CROP PEST AND DISEASE CONTROL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.3: Crop Pest and Disease Control

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Crop Pest and Disease Control. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: CROP PEST AND DISEASE CONTROL
This lesson teaches Crop Pest and Disease Control for Grade 8 AGRICULTURE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Crop Pest and Disease Control using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Crop Pest and Disease Control above.
2. Explain Crop Pest and Disease Control to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Crop Pest and Disease Control.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Crop Pest and Disease Control with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Crop Pest and Disease Control important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases?
2. How can we control pests and diseases affecting crops?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
